## Context

Only justified cross-tool step: independent review / cost control.

## Task

1. Pick an open or newly created PR from Lab 05 or 06.
2. Have the **other** tool review the diff (`opencode run` or `claude -p`) on a different model if available.
3. Post review comments on the PR; fix at least one actionable finding or document why none.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Review comment visible on the PR.
- [ ] Short note in PR: why a second tool was worth it (independence / cost / second opinion).
- [ ] Still no custom orchestration bus — one-shot CLI review only.

## Out of scope

- Command Center as pass criteria.
